data.body: [P2] Reject malformed matcher mappings in every branch. With `allowed_keys=None`, mappings other than an exact `$any_of` are recursively accepted, so `name: {$any_of: [child, {$anyof: []}]}` or an inactive occurrence containing `name: {$bogus: x}` passes schema validation; another matching alternative/count then lets the invalid requirement succeed. Make validation property-aware: scalar span properties should accept only scalar matchers or recursively valid `$any_of`, while arbitrary mappings remain allowed for `attributes` and serialized link shapes are validated separately. Add inactive parent/count regressions for unknown nested matcher controls.
